{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Youmay|an [[in-universe]] storage device|[[Databank (2014-)|the official online "Databank" encyclopedia]] or the [[Databank (original)|previous version of it]]|linebreak=1}}
{{Quote|You'd be ''amazed'' how much ''top secret'' information is stored in my memory banks.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Memory Loss">{{SWComicCite|7.13|Memory Loss}}</ref>}}
A '''memory bank''',<ref name="Yoda's Challenge">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref> '''memory core''',<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> '''data bank''',<ref name="Riders">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> or '''memory log'''<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> was a device found in [[Droid/Legends|droids]], where data was stored.<ref name="TD">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|According to his memory logs, he fired the emergency thrusters on the escape pod to avoid a midair collusion.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] "[[Cody/Legends|Cody]]," on the memory logs of a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]|<ref name="TD" />}}
The term "memory log" was first introduced in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" /> It was later reused in "[[The Deserter]]",<ref name="TD" /> only for its episode guide to use the term "memory banks,"<ref name="TD guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}}</ref> thereby establishing "memory log" as an alternate name for a memory core.
